officialEdition.publisher: Publishing House of the Moscow Patriarchate
officialEdition.scope: Publisher's 11-page preview: January–August calendar pages. Only calendar facts were consulted; unrelated text and illustrations were not reproduced.

resolvedDiscrepancy: Eve of Theophany is 18 January. Akafistnik's annual page incorrectly lists 17 January; its daily page for 18 January and Azbyka's annual calendar confirm 18 January. The owner also confirmed 18 January.
publicationScope: Original short labels and factual dates, with source links. No copied daily saints' biographies, readings, illustrations or detailed dietary rules.
localPractice: External old-style reference calendar; not asserted to be the binding local rule of the ISF community.
